title: T76 (Tinyana) PNC - Yisrael Na'asim Adonim L'Ba'aleihem — Conquering the Galus, V'Nishar Gam Hu L'Elokeinu, and the Acrostic of GoLaH
hebrewTitle: ישראל נעשים אדונים לבעליהם — כיבוש הגלות, ונשאר גם הוא לאלקינו, וראשי תיבות גולה
author: Pettek Nanach

beginner.en: **"Yisrael hem na'asim adonim l'ba'aleihem."** Rabbeinu opens with the strange but precise principle Chazal teach (**Sanhedrin 104a**): **"כָּל מָקוֹם שֶׁהֵם הוֹלְכִים נַעֲשִׂים שָׂרִים לַאֲדוֹנֵיהֶם"** — every place Yisrael goes in galus, *they become officers to their masters*. The pattern in every land of exile is the same: at the *beginning*, *kvushim ba-golah* — they arrive subjugated, ground down. *But afterward*, **they become *adonim* to their *ba'alim*** — they end up *conquering the place itself*. Not by sword: by spiritual elevation. **The mechanism**: *Yisrael are the ones who lift fallen places*. The proof-text is one of the gentlest astonishments Chazal ever wrote: **Megillah 6a** — *asidin batei tartiyaos v'kirkasiyaos she-yilm'du ba-hen Torah ba-rabim*, *the theaters and circuses* of Rome are destined, in the future, to be lecture-halls of Torah. Not destroyed; not razed. *Used*. The very buildings that hosted gladiatorial blood-sport will, on the same stones, host yeshivah. *V'nishar gam hu l'Elokeinu* (**Zechariah 9:7**) — "and even *he* shall remain for our G-d" — the pasuk speaks of Plishti remnants becoming consecrated; Chazal extend it to all the institutions of the umos. **Yisrael's signature** is therefore the *upward translation of the fallen place*. Whatever room you walk into in galus, however degraded, ends up — through the slow lift of Jewish presence — *belonging to Him*. **And this is precisely why they are called *b'nei ha-golah***. The name carries the secret of its own reversal: **גּוֹלָה = ראשי תיבות "וְנִשְׁאָר גַּם הוּא לֵאלֹקֵינוּ"** — the four letters of *Golah* (ג, ו, ל, ה) are exactly the rashei teivos of *V'nishar Gam Hu l'Elokeinu* (ו, ג, ה, ל). They are *called* exiles because, *in the end*, they will redeem and consecrate the very places of their exile. The name *Golah* is not a wound; it is a job-description. *V'al kein nikraim b'nei ha-Golah* — because the work of consecrating the *theaters and circuses for Torah* is what Jews-in-Galus actually do, and the name records the mission. **Take-home, gentle**: every place a Jew is forced into is the place a Jew will eventually *raise*. The first stage feels like grinding subjugation — *na v'nad ba-golah*. The second stage is the same place becoming a beis midrash. The first stage doesn't get skipped, but the second stage doesn't get missed either. *V'nishar gam hu l'Elokeinu*: even *that one* — the place you thought was lost forever — *remains for our G-d*.

intermediate.en: **Pesicha**: *Yisrael na'asim adonim l'ba'aleihem.* **Sanhedrin 104a**: "כָּל מָקוֹם שֶׁהֵם הוֹלְכִים נַעֲשִׂים שָׂרִים לַאֲדוֹנֵיהֶם." Pattern: at first kvushim ba-golah, then become adonim — kovshim es ha-makom not by sword but by spiritual elevation. **Mechanism**: *Yisrael are the ones who lift fallen places.* **Megillah 6a**: *asidin batei tartiyaos v'kirkasiyaos she-yilm'du ba-hen Torah ba-rabim* — Roman theaters/circuses become future Torah-halls. **Zech 9:7 "וְנִשְׁאָר גַּם הוּא לֵאלֹקֵינוּ."** Yisrael's signature = upward translation of the fallen place. **Acrostic**: **גּוֹלָה = ראשי תיבות "וְנִשְׁאָר גַּם הוּא לֵאלֹקֵינוּ"** — the very name *Golah* spells out the redemption. The name records the mission, not the wound. **Take-home**: every place a Jew is forced into is the place a Jew will eventually raise. Stage 1 — subjugation, *na v'nad*. Stage 2 — the same place becomes a beis midrash. Stage 1 not skipped; stage 2 not missed.

scholarly.he: [T2:76א] ישראל נעשים אדונים לבעליהם (סנה' קד). שלב א': כבושים. שלב ב': כובשים את המקום ע"י הרמה. "בתי תרטיאות וקרקסיאות עתידים להיות בתי מדרש" (מגילה ו). זכריה ט:ז "ונשאר גם הוא לאלקינו." גוֹלָה = ר"ת ונשאר גם הוא לאלקינו (ו,ג,ה,ל = ג,ו,ל,ה). שם הגלות כולל בתוכו את התיקון.
